mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_change_log (change_no, order_no, product_id, quantity, operation_type, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{changeNo}, #{orderNo}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{operationType}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT product_id AS productId, COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) AS pendingQuantity FROM stock_change_log WHERE operation_type = 1 AND status = 0 GROUP BY product_id
